verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an API-first inference provider. It documents OpenAI-compatible (Chat Completions, Responses, speech to text) and Anthropic Messages APIs, with Bearer/X-API-Key auth, request schemas, code examples and a playground. Probes confirm a live OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json plus llms.txt and Markdown docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real API calls succeeding beyond the existence of the published spec and docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Munito AI supports the OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and speech to text APIs, plus the Anthropic Messages API.
Explore the API. Request schemas, code examples, and an API playground.
Send your key in `Authorization: Bearer` or `X-API-Key`.
The full Markdown document includes the guides and public API contract.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.munito.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
